regression_matrix.title: Invisible content rendering on all destination detail pages
regression_matrix.evidence: All 10 sampled destination pages returned 200 with 300k+ HTML, proper h1/h2/h3 hierarchy, JSON-LD blocks, confidence-card references in body. Consider marking FIXED pending browser validation.

regression_matrix.title: Only 1 of 20 collections rendering
regression_matrix.evidence: /en/collections listed 91 collection links; sample /en/collections/best-beaches-india loaded 200 with correct title + h1.

regression_matrix.title: 503 Service Unavailable on RSC prefetch
regression_matrix.evidence: 3× retries of /en/destination/jaipur with RSC: 1 header returned 200 each time. One transient 500 was seen on an earlier run but not reproducible. Needs Chrome/browser session for full prefetch-path verification.

regression_matrix.title: Empty modal flash between wizard steps
regression_matrix.evidence: Requires interactive browser session; no Chrome MCP available today.

regression_matrix.title: Hindi translation only partially applied
regression_matrix.evidence: Panaji and Munnar /hi/ pages have English title and English h1 despite html lang=hi and body containing Devanagari content (5801 chars each). Other 8 sampled destinations correctly localize h1+title. State names (e.g., 'Rajasthan', 'Kerala') remain untranslated in HI titles for every destination. HI collection page title also unlocalized: /hi/collections/best-beaches-india returns English 'Best Beaches in India — Beyond Goa — Collection | NakshIQ'.

regression_matrix.title: Duration field shows '- days' (missing data)
regression_matrix.evidence: No '- days' tokens found in any sampled destination page; valid 'N days' values present.

regression_matrix.title: Map markers vs results count mismatch
regression_matrix.evidence: Requires Leaflet interaction in a live browser.

regression_matrix.title: Duplicate 'NakshIQ' in destination page titles
regression_matrix.evidence: All 10 destination titles contain exactly one 'NakshIQ' token (brand suffix only).

regression_matrix.title: Treks page title contradicts body content count
regression_matrix.evidence: /en/treks h1='Treks & Hikes', body claims 130 scored trails, and 130 unique /en/treks/<slug> card links were found — counts are consistent.

regression_matrix.title: Card images slow to load (lazy loading too aggressive)
regression_matrix.evidence: HTML itself loads in ~2s for destination pages; actual image lazy-load timing cannot be measured without a browser. No regression apparent at HTML level.

new_defects.title: Invalid destination slugs return HTTP 200 (soft-404)
new_defects.evidence: GET https://www.nakshiq.com/en/destination/this-does-not-exist-xyz → 200 with homepage title 'NakshIQ — Travel Intelligence for India'. Second probe with slug 'aaaa' also 200. Expected: 404.
new_defects.impact: Google Search Console will flag these as soft-404; wastes crawl budget; users can share malformed URLs that look legitimate.

new_defects.title: HI localization missing for specific destinations (Panaji, Munnar) and all state names in titles
new_defects.evidence: Title/h1 English on /hi/destination/panaji and /hi/destination/munnar. State tokens (Rajasthan, Kerala, Uttar Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Ladakh, West Bengal, Goa) remain English in every sampled HI title. HI collection page title also in English.
new_defects.impact: Inconsistent HI UX; SEO signal mismatch with html lang=hi; brand voice partially broken.
new_defects.recommended_owner: packages/shared i18n maps + destination/state translation tables

new_defects.title: /plan cold-start latency ~12.8s SSR / ~14s RSC
new_defects.evidence: First request to /en/plan took 12.81s; /hi/plan 12.34s; RSC prefetch of /en/plan cold 14.15s. Warm retries ~3.28s.
new_defects.impact: First-visit users (incl. bots, Lighthouse runs) see very slow plan page. LCP will fail.
new_defects.recommended_owner: apps/web /en/plan server component — check Supabase query fan-out + AI SDK lazy init

new_defects.title: /cost-index serves 2.6 MB HTML in ~7s
new_defects.evidence: EN 7.16s / 2,648,163 bytes; HI 7.02s / 2,659,365 bytes. Likely every cost row inlined in initial HTML.
new_defects.impact: High TTFB + bloated DOM; mobile users especially impacted.
new_defects.recommended_owner: apps/web cost-index route — consider pagination or virtualization

new_defects.title: /search and /news return 404 despite appearing in navigation patterns
new_defects.evidence: GET /en/search → 404; GET /en/news → 404 (both EN and HI). Confirm whether these are intentional or missing implementations.
